capabilities: Import a Daylio CSV export placed in the vault
Render mood entries as a color-coded graph
Annotate the graph with single-date point events from note properties
Annotate the graph with multi-day range events
Open the graph via ribbon icon or command in a split pane
disambiguation: Does not track mood itself; it only visualizes an existing CSV export from the Daylio app.
extras: Offers a downloadable demo vault with pre-configured sample data; in-depth technical documentation is deferred to an Architecture section in AGENTS.md rather than the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize mood-tracking data from Daylio alongside daily notes and vault events.

relations.evidence: renders Daylio mood data as a color-coded graph, annotated with Obsidian vault entries

summary: Renders Daylio mood tracker data as a color-coded graph in a split pane, annotated with events from vault note properties.
